message: 너와 나의 사이가, 우리 모두의 세계로.
approved_direction: Retain two distinct colors and identities; lean together, open the same particles into a galaxy, offer voluntary exploration without redirect.

scenes.event: Hold SAI lettering through the original final chord and a breath.
The two colors reform into two seated figures in contact.
Hold the two distinct figures before expanding their relationship.
The same particle IDs unfold into spiral arms; a small trace of the figures remains at the origin.
The camera retreats; gentle differential rotation reveals a larger world.
Closing phrase, score resolution, and voluntary galaxy link.

catalog_application.adaptation: No disappearance or opacity wipe: preserve point IDs through lettering, distinct figures, and galaxy targets. Existing GSAP paused timeline owns the morph.
Seeded four-arm galaxy and 2:1 inner-to-outer angular speed in the vertex shader. Driven only by media time, not a second animation loop.

human_acceptance: Pending review of the implemented coda. Direction approved; technical validation is not aesthetic acceptance.
